temporalIdentities.name: OBSERVATION_TIME
temporalIdentities.meaning: Provider event/sample time when authoritative; legacy observedAt can be nominal and must not be assumed instant.

temporalIdentities.name: REPRESENTED_TIME
temporalIdentities.meaning: Time attributed to evidence; must reconcile with support and product definition.

temporalIdentities.name: SUPPORT_START
temporalIdentities.meaning: Beginning of interval/composite information support; not publication time.

temporalIdentities.name: SUPPORT_END
temporalIdentities.meaning: Latest represented support bound only when complete and authoritative; required for no-future necessary check.

temporalIdentities.name: NOMINAL_PRODUCT_TIME
temporalIdentities.meaning: Label/analysis time; alone cannot prove full support or causal mapping window.

temporalIdentities.name: PUBLICATION_TIME
temporalIdentities.meaning: Exact revision release/availability provenance; nullable Frame field, absent from legacy endpoint capture.

temporalIdentities.name: RETRIEVAL_TIME
temporalIdentities.meaning: Operational fetch time; later fetch neither proves earlier knowledge nor proves product first became available then.

temporalIdentities.name: ARCHIVE_CAPTURE_TIME
temporalIdentities.meaning: Receipt/storage time and identity; preserve as-used payload but not automatically first availability.

temporalIdentities.name: ASSESSMENT_TIME
temporalIdentities.meaning: Explicit immutable assessmentAt; scheduled cycle time or outer request capture.

principles.text: No evidence representing information beyond assessmentAt may contribute. Timestamp <= assessment is necessary only when that timestamp actually describes all required support.
Represented-before and known-as-of are distinct. Exact replay identity is a third obligation; being eligible does not mean it was actually used.
Authoritatively instant support at/before assessment passes represented bound; after fails, no tolerance. Full qualification additionally needs source/revision/availability and consumer rules.

For a complete authoritative interval, end<=assessment is necessary. End==assessment passes this bound; straddling/entirely future support must not be silently clipped or flattened. Full product support/composite semantics remain unresolved.

Nominal time does not prove contributor/analysis support or no later reconstruction inputs. Require product-specific support/causal-window and exact-vintage availability evidence; no direct/gap equivalence.
Static context is not repeated observation and has no elapsed observation cutoff. Exact as-used model/map revision availability still matters.
Later revision cannot replace earlier as-used identity; retrospective alternatives need separate explicit authority. Same support adds no temporal span.

Active scientific selection must receive validated assessmentAt. Missing/invalid context must reject or yield no qualified history using existing boundary conventions; never new Date.now fallback internally.

Retrieval filtering is only a coarse optimization. Adapter verifies temporal metadata consistency; consumer-aware selection owns assessment/source-support/revision authority; consumers validate their required facts and arithmetic.
Fixed exact evidence references/selected identities, assessment, selection/evaluator version and policy must stay bound. Re-running an unbounded live query later is not deterministic replay.
Keep original source and as-used outputs unchanged. Document missing qualification rather than filling unknown publication/support metadata.
Valid source facts survive a failed temporal derivation; failed dependent results cannot retain invalid arithmetic/lifecycle/confidence. No arithmetic repair here.

handoff.contextLost: No assessmentAt/observedBefore passed to retrieveOceanMemoryRows, buildHistoricalSnapshotQuery, buildOceanMemoryTimeSeries or leaf persistence handoff.
handoff.proof: Faithful synthetic storage response through actual boundaries, not low-level function-only input.

cases.asUsed: Potentially eligible only with exact actual-used identity and all other requirements; cannot add merely eligible evidence to frozen replay.
cases.retrospective: May be considered under separate selection policy.

cases.asUsed: Not admissible as knowledge at earlier assessment; later version cannot be inserted into earlier replay.
cases.retrospective: Potentially eligible, separately declared; no retrospective policy qualified.
May be labeled future/outcome context, never backdated contemporaneous evidence.

cases.asUsed: Cannot replace bound original. No new elapsed observation.
cases.retrospective: Only explicit separately governed revision analysis.

metadata.frame: Support discriminated union, observationTime, nullable providerPublishedAt, required acquiredAt, nullable processedAt, product/provenance/lineage. Structural representation not consumer admission.
metadata.capture: V1/v2 point observedAt and source metadata; no providerPublishedAt/support interval/first-availability field. Exact bytes preserved; opaque lineage may point elsewhere but no resolver proves missing facts.
metadata.legacy: Envelope observedAt/generatedAt and row created_at/stored_at are not authoritative publication/support facts. Family observedAt can differ; adapter does not reconcile all family clocks.
metadata.publication: V3 supplies cycle assessment and history evaluatedAt<=asOf. Environmental freezeEvidence checks representedAt<=assessedAt but does not require interval/composite support.end<=assessment or exact revision publication availability.
metadata.knownAsOf: Requires trustworthy availability/causal-vintage evidence for exact referenced product plus actual-used binding. A late acquisition does not prove first availability; an immutable later-written cycle reference does not itself prove earlier knowledge.
historicalCompatibility: QUALIFIABLE_FOR_REPRESENTED_TIME_ONLY only when instant/support authority established
UNQUALIFIED_FOR_AS_USED_REPLAY scientific as-of admission when availability/support unproven; exact mechanical replay still possible and must preserve original record
RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY is a possible explicitly governed use, not automatic qualification

familyFindings.sst: Existing qualified synthetic SST view is instant-only, <=assessment, >=2 observations and positive span, missing filtered, identity/revision checks. No authority to call every legacy SST envelope instant or known-as-of.
familyFindings.chlorophyllDirect: Leaf prefers productivity/clarity evidence time; nominal daily product timestamp not qualified full support. Exact publication/revision availability missing.
familyFindings.chlorophyllGapFilled: Separate reconstructed lineage preserved. Contributor/analysis support and causal vintage not inferable from nominal date; no equivalence to direct.
familyFindings.current: Legacy persistence uses snapshot envelope with finite speed/direction; source u/v identity and represented time remain separately preserved. Cache refresh not observation. Product-support/availability qualification unresolved; no convergence interpretation.
familyFindings.features: Temporal plumbing is envelope based or inherited first/last feature window. Dependency observations must meet cutoff; labels do not establish identity. Association/movement remain unwired and not newly qualified.
familyFindings.opportunity: Decision evaluation time is distinct. V3 rejects evaluatedAt>asOf; existing private decision fallback supplies evaluatedBefore. No ranking change.
familyFindings.documentary: Two consumers remain documentary. Future retrospective narrative cannot become earlier scientific input.
familyFindings.static: No repeated temporal-observation role; exact vintage and as-used context remain separate.

enforcement.retrieval: Optional coarse observed-time filter cannot resolve family/envelope mismatch, intervals, revisions, non-database replay or availability.
enforcement.adapter: Preserve/validate source facts and consistency; not a new global policy.
enforcement.selector: Require explicit validated assessment; inspect consumer required support and exact product/revision authority; fail closed if authority missing.
enforcement.primitive: Preserves known temporal distinctions; representation validator is not selector. No demonstrated schema amendment needed for already representable support fields.
enforcement.consumer: Defense in depth against inadmissible required inputs/nonfinite derived facts; no implicit clock or recomputation bypass.
enforcement.missingAssessment: Use existing TypeError rejection at strict context boundary; do not silently return an apparently qualified empty series or fall back to wall clock.

overflow.limit: No arithmetic modified. Both dated chlorophyll endpoints precede Sep24 01Z target; cutoff alone does not cure subtraction. Known-as-of/support unknown prevents full eligibility claim.

versionReview.result: REVIEW_AND_VERSION_REQUIRED for new mandatory assessment/support/admission and deterministic selected-set identity; no selector authored.
No automatic successor; existing support/provenance fields preserved. Missing product semantics are not fixed by version label.
Review/version semantic configuration and exact frozen history binding when selection changes; no historical replay through new live query.
Existing binding capability sufficient for exact referenced selection/policy inputs; no V3 schema amendment demonstrated.
Immutable objects/identities unchanged. Missing temporal provenance may require separately reviewed referenced evidence contract; never retrofit guessed dates.
Separate retrospective mode/version and provenance required before implementation; must not rewrite earlier as-used history.

boundaries.lookback: No universal past horizon selected; cutoff only forbids future information.
boundaries.privacy: Cutoff derives from scientific assessment/source facts, not captain identity. Existing private resolver does not become shared history; synthetic owner/token only, no service access.
boundaries.nightly: May inspect later evidence only as separately labeled retrospective/audit input; original assessment/source references unchanged.
boundaries.replay: Explicit-clock invariance tested. Complete history-selection determinism not established without frozen input/policy/revision/availability authority.

blockers: Legacy historical payloads do not establish authoritative full support for all active products.
Exact revision known-as-of availability absent/unresolved; publication nominal/created/retrieved time cannot be substituted.
No qualified consumer-aware selector or resolved shared historical payload/vintage manifest.
Same-support revision precedence and deterministic frozen selected-set semantics still need review.
nextGate: ACTIVE HISTORICAL TEMPORAL-PROVENANCE QUALIFICATION: identify authoritative support/causal-window and exact revision availability evidence (or explicit unknown) for each active source payload; specify exact as-used reference/selection binding. Then resume consumer-aware history selection, temporal-derived finiteness, cross-route normalization in that order. No implementation.
